newsitem.title: USA: Staffmark says acquisition to aid 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Staffmark says acquisition to aid 1997 EPS.

text.p: StaffMark, Inc said Monday it had acquired Lindenberg & Associates, an information technology consulting firm based in St. Louis, Missouri, and expected the purchase to boost 1997 earnings per share.
StaffMark, which did not disclose terms of the purchase, said Lindenberg & Associates had revenues in 1996 of $18 million.

"The acquisition of Lindenberg & Associates is a significant step toward our objective of growing StaffMark's professional/information technology revenues," said Clete Brewer, StaffMark's president and chief executive officer. "Because of the technical expertise required, information technology staffing and consulting generally has a higher profit margin than commercial staffing," he added.
